target.title: Avengers: Doomsday
target.notes: Compiled 2026-10-07 from public watch-guides and the confirmed cast. The cast is not final. Series entries (Loki, WandaVision, FATWS) are included because the story depends on them.

tiers.essential: Skipping these leaves real plot gaps

image_notes: Artwork was retrieved from TMDB into this local collection; review licensing before public deployment.

movies.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
movies.description: Steve Rogers becomes Captain America in WWII and meets Peggy Carter.
movies.doomsday_connection: Origin of Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter, both in Doomsday.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.description: Tony Stark builds the Iron Man suit and begins the MCU.
movies.doomsday_connection: Robert Downey Jr.'s MCU start; he returns as Doom in Doomsday.

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.description: Tony faces Whiplash while S.H.I.E.L.D. watches him.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces War Machine and Black Widow.

movies.title: Thor
movies.description: Thor is banished to Earth and Loki schemes for the throne.
movies.doomsday_connection: Origin of Thor and Loki, both in Doomsday.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.description: Earth's heroes unite to stop Loki's invasion.
movies.doomsday_connection: The original team-up template.

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.description: Tony battles the Mandarin and Extremis while dealing with PTSD.
movies.doomsday_connection: Background on Tony Stark.

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World
movies.description: Thor faces the Dark Elves and the Aether.
movies.doomsday_connection: Loki's arc and the Reality Stone.

movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
movies.description: Steve Rogers uncovers HYDRA inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and faces Bucky as the Winter Soldier.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces Sam Wilson as an ally and Bucky's return.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
movies.description: A group of outlaws unites to stop Ronan.
movies.doomsday_connection: Cosmic background. No confirmed Doomsday cast.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
movies.description: Peter Quill meets his father Ego.
movies.doomsday_connection: Cosmic background. No confirmed Doomsday cast.

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
movies.description: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner create Ultron, and the Avengers face the consequences.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces Vision and the Avengers' fracture.

movies.title: Ant-Man
movies.description: Scott Lang becomes Ant-Man and introduces the Quantum Realm.
movies.doomsday_connection: Origin of Scott Lang, in Doomsday.

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.description: The Avengers split over the Sokovia Accords.
movies.doomsday_connection: Bucky, Sam, Steve and Scott are all in Doomsday; Black Panther and Spider-Man debut.

movies.title: Black Widow
movies.description: Natasha Romanoff confronts her past and the Red Room, reuniting with Yelena and Alexei.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces Yelena Belova and Red Guardian, both in Doomsday.

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.description: T'Challa becomes king of Wakanda and faces Killmonger.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces Shuri and M'Baku.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.description: Peter Parker (Tom Holland), mentored by Tony Stark, tries to prove himself as a hero while chasing Adrian Toomes, the Vulture, and keeping up with high school.
movies.doomsday_connection: Peter's MCU origin.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.description: Stephen Strange becomes a sorcerer and learns the mystic arts.
movies.doomsday_connection: Origin of Doctor Strange.

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok
movies.description: Thor faces Hela and the destruction of Asgard.
movies.doomsday_connection: Thor's arc into Infinity War.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
movies.description: Scott, Hope and Hank search for Janet in the Quantum Realm and face Ghost.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces Ghost, confirmed for Doomsday.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.description: Thanos collects the Infinity Stones and snaps away half of all life.
movies.doomsday_connection: Needed context for Endgame.

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.description: Carol Danvers becomes Captain Marvel in the 1990s.
movies.doomsday_connection: No confirmed Doomsday cast.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.description: Five years after Thanos snaps half of all life away, the surviving Avengers pull off a time heist to undo it. Tony Stark dies, and Steve Rogers stays in the past with Peggy Carter.
movies.doomsday_connection: The emotional and narrative baseline of Doomsday. Steve Rogers' ending is where his return picks up.

movies.title: WandaVision
movies.description: Wanda Maximoff's grief traps a town in a sitcom reality and she becomes the Scarlet Witch.
movies.doomsday_connection: Foundation for Multiverse of Madness.

movies.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
movies.description: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes deal with Steve Rogers' legacy as Sam decides whether to accept the shield.
movies.doomsday_connection: Explains how Sam became Captain America and introduces John Walker and Joaquin Torres.

tmdb_lookup.query: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

movies.title: Loki (Season 1)
movies.description: A variant of Loki is pulled into the Time Variance Authority, which exists to protect a single Sacred Timeline. The season ends with the killing of He Who Remains, a Kang variant.
movies.doomsday_connection: Explains how the multiverse was set loose and why variants of characters (including a Doom variant) can exist.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movies.description: On a school trip to Europe, Peter is recruited by Nick Fury to face the Elementals with Mysterio, whose true plan ends with Peter's identity exposed.
movies.doomsday_connection: Leads directly into No Way Home.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.description: Shang-Chi confronts his father and the Ten Rings organization and takes on the Ten Rings himself.
movies.doomsday_connection: Shang-Chi is confirmed for Doomsday and the beacon at the end of his film has not been resolved.

tmdb_lookup.query: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

movies.title: Spider-Man
movies.description: Bitten by a genetically engineered spider, Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) gains powers, loses Uncle Ben, and becomes Spider-Man while Norman Osborn turns into the Green Goblin.
movies.doomsday_connection: Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man returns in No Way Home.

movies.title: Spider-Man 2
movies.description: Peter's double life wears him down as he quits being Spider-Man, then returns to stop Dr. Otto Octavius, whose fusion experiment turns him into Doctor Octopus.
movies.doomsday_connection: Doc Ock returns in No Way Home.

movies.title: Spider-Man 3
movies.description: Peter's life is complicated by the alien symbiote suit, Harry's revenge as the New Goblin, and the Sandman, whose connection to Uncle Ben's death is revealed.
movies.doomsday_connection: Sandman returns in No Way Home.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
movies.description: A reboot: Peter Parker (Andrew Garfield) learns about his parents' past, gets his powers, and falls for Gwen Stacy while facing Dr. Curt Connors as the Lizard.
movies.doomsday_connection: Andrew Garfield's Spider-Man returns in No Way Home.
movies.franchise: The Amazing Spider-Man (Marc Webb, Andrew Garfield)

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
movies.description: Peter's relationship with Gwen Stacy and the truth about his parents collide with Electro and Harry Osborn's Green Goblin, ending in tragedy.
movies.doomsday_connection: Electro returns in No Way Home.
movies.franchise: The Amazing Spider-Man (Marc Webb, Andrew Garfield)

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
movies.description: After Mysterio exposes him, Peter asks Doctor Strange to make the world forget; the spell tears open the multiverse, and Spider-Men and villains from other universes arrive.
movies.doomsday_connection: Opens the multiverse on screen and shows other universes' characters crossing into the MCU.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.description: Doctor Strange travels across universes to protect America Chavez from Wanda Maximoff, who is hunting for her children.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces incursions, the collision of two universes that can destroy both, the central multiverse threat.

tmdb_lookup.query: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
movies.description: Thor teams up with Jane Foster, who wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor, to stop Gorr the God Butcher.
movies.doomsday_connection: Sets up Thor's current status and his adopted daughter Love.

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
movies.description: Wakanda mourns T'Challa and Shuri takes up the Black Panther mantle while facing Namor and the underwater kingdom of Talokan.
movies.doomsday_connection: Sets up Shuri and Namor, both confirmed for Doomsday.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
movies.description: Scott Lang, Hope, Hank, Janet and Cassie are pulled into the Quantum Realm, where they face Kang the Conqueror.
movies.doomsday_connection: Establishes the Kang threat and the idea of many variants of one villain, the same setup Doomsday uses for Doom.

movies.title: Loki (Season 2)
movies.description: The timelines begin to unravel and Loki makes a sacrifice to hold the branching multiverse together.
movies.doomsday_connection: Sets the state of the multiverse that Doomsday plays out in.

movies.title: X-Men
movies.description: Professor Xavier's X-Men face Magneto's Brotherhood as Wolverine and Rogue join the team.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces the original cast confirmed for Doomsday.

movies.title: X2: X-Men United
movies.description: Colonel Stryker attacks Xavier's school, forcing the X-Men and Magneto's Brotherhood to team up. Jean Grey sacrifices herself at the end.
movies.doomsday_connection: Nightcrawler (Alan Cumming) first appears here and is in the Doomsday cast.

movies.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
movies.description: A mutant 'cure' divides the community as Jean Grey returns as the Phoenix. Xavier dies and Magneto loses his powers.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces Kelsey Grammer's Beast. Days of Future Past later rewrites this timeline.

movies.title: X-Men: First Class
movies.description: The origin of the friendship and split between Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr during the 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis.
movies.doomsday_connection: Shows the origin of the Xavier and Magneto relationship.

movies.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
movies.description: Wolverine's consciousness is sent back to 1973 to stop an event that leads to a future ruled by Sentinels. This rewrites the timeline.
movies.doomsday_connection: Important for understanding which version of the X-Men exists going into Doomsday.

movies.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
movies.description: The young X-Men face En Sabah Nur, the first mutant, in 1983.
movies.doomsday_connection: Completes the rebooted Fox timeline.

movies.title: Dark Phoenix
movies.description: Jean Grey absorbs a cosmic force that makes her dangerously powerful.
movies.doomsday_connection: The last Fox X-Men film before Deadpool & Wolverine.

movies.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
movies.description: Wolverine's backstory, including his brother Sabretooth and the Weapon X program. Deadpool also appears.
movies.doomsday_connection: Optional. Deadpool & Wolverine jokes about it. Nothing here is confirmed for Doomsday.

movies.title: The Wolverine
movies.description: Logan travels to Japan, grieving Jean Grey, and faces a threat to a dying industrialist.
movies.doomsday_connection: Optional side story; its post-credits scene sets up Days of Future Past.

movies.title: Logan
movies.description: In 2029, an aging Logan protects a young mutant, Laura, in a world where mutants have nearly vanished. Logan dies at the end.
movies.doomsday_connection: The emotional core of Deadpool & Wolverine.

movies.title: Deadpool
movies.description: Wade Wilson becomes the mutant mercenary Deadpool after an experiment and hunts the man who disfigured him.
movies.doomsday_connection: Origin of Deadpool, the character Deadpool & Wolverine builds on.

movies.title: Deadpool 2
movies.description: Deadpool forms X-Force to protect a young mutant from the time-traveling Cable.
movies.doomsday_connection: Sets up the found-family theme that carries into Deadpool & Wolverine.

movies.title: Blade
movies.description: Half-vampire Blade hunts vampires.
movies.doomsday_connection: Wesley Snipes' Blade appears in Deadpool & Wolverine.

movies.title: Blade II
movies.description: Blade teams with vampires against a new breed of enemy.
movies.doomsday_connection: Background for the D&W Blade cameo.

movies.title: Blade: Trinity
movies.description: Blade joins the Nightstalkers against Dracula.
movies.doomsday_connection: Background for the D&W Blade cameo.

movies.title: Daredevil
movies.description: Matt Murdock fights crime as Daredevil.
movies.doomsday_connection: Ben Affleck's Daredevil appears in Deadpool & Wolverine.

movies.title: Elektra
movies.description: Elektra, an assassin, protects a father and daughter.
movies.doomsday_connection: Jennifer Garner's Elektra appears in Deadpool & Wolverine.

movies.title: Fantastic Four
movies.description: Four astronauts gain powers from cosmic rays and face Victor Von Doom.
movies.doomsday_connection: Chris Evans' Johnny Storm appears in Deadpool & Wolverine; also an earlier take on Doom.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.description: Wade Wilson is recruited by the TVA and teams up with a reluctant Wolverine to stop the erasure of the Fox timeline and defeat Cassandra Nova.
movies.doomsday_connection: The bridge between the Fox X-Men universe and the MCU. It is why the original X-Men cast can appear in Doomsday.

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World
movies.description: Sam Wilson, now Captain America, uncovers a conspiracy involving President Thaddeus Ross and the Leader.
movies.doomsday_connection: Continues Sam Wilson's story as Captain America into Doomsday.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.description: A team of misfit anti-heroes led by Yelena Belova confronts the Void, a threat born from Bob Reynolds / Sentry.
movies.doomsday_connection: Introduces the team that goes into Doomsday. Its post-credits scene also shows the Fantastic Four's ship arriving in the main MCU.

movies.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
movies.description: Marvel's First Family protects an alternate 1960s Earth from Galactus and the Silver Surfer.
movies.doomsday_connection: Doctor Doom makes his MCU debut here, and the post-credits scene sets up the Fantastic Four's arrival in the main timeline.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: With the world having forgotten who he is, Peter Parker (Tom Holland) lives a quieter, more isolated life as a street-level Spider-Man.
movies.doomsday_connection: The last MCU release before Doomsday. Its post-credits scene is a Doomsday tease, though Tom Holland was not confirmed for the film.

spider_man.note: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is the only one with a confirmed Doomsday tease; the Holland, Maguire and Garfield films are included because of No Way Home. Tom Holland's presence in Doomsday is not confirmed.
